title: Knockout wordmark as a window onto a moving ground
summary: SVG `<mask>` subtracting the wordmark's paths from a solid `--ground` rect that overflows the word's box and is clipped by the hero, over a fixed canvas-2D ground (four Lissajous blobs + light / shade folds at 1/6 resolution) on the shared ticker, stopped off-screen; `h1` with a hidden text twin, no media files, one still frame under reduced motion
variants: SVG <mask> with the glyph paths subtracted from a solid rect, over a fixed canvas-2D ground (this, default)
fixed muted playsinline <video> as the ground, paused on its poster frame under reduced motion
three.js shader ground (three@0.186.0) when the ground has to answer the pointer or scroll
